roleContext.jobDescription: Greyfriars runs an investment platform used by financial advisers and their clients. The Operations Change Analyst designs new operational workflows in the case-management system, coordinates testing with the client services team, takes approved workflows into live operation with a documented go-live sign-off and a hypercare period, and keeps the procedures library current. Changes are expected to be measured on processing times before and after release. The operations team of about 70 people handles new accounts, transfers and corporate actions, all workflow changes pass through the platform's change committee, and the analyst reports to the head of operations change.

requirements.text: Designs operational workflows in a case-management or workflow system.
Coordinates testing with operations teams before release.
Has taken a new workflow into live operation with a documented go-live sign-off and a hypercare period.
Measures processing times before and after workflow changes.

# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Operations Change Analyst, Wealth Platform

## Experience

- Business Analyst, Meridian Wrap Services, August 2020 to July 2024: designed the client-onboarding workflow in the case-management system, replacing a spreadsheet tracker with twelve case stages and automatic task assignment by case type and adviser firm.
- Coordinated three test cycles with the client services team in the test instance and triaged 41 defects with the vendor's configuration team, keeping a shared defect log with severity and retest dates.
- Took the onboarding workflow into live operation on 2 October 2023 once the operations director had signed the go-live approval, then ran a four-week hypercare desk with a daily defect call attended by the vendor.
- Rewrote 18 procedures in the operations manual to match the new case stages and withdrew the spreadsheet-era procedures after review by the operations risk lead.
- Built a dashboard of onboarding cases opened and closed each week after go-live for the client services manager, refreshed each morning from the case-management system.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the hypercare close report for the onboarding workflow, with the signed go-live approval dated 29 September 2023, the live date of 2 October 2023, four weeks of daily defect logs and the handover to business-as-usual support, signed by the operations director.
